subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw publish `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a supported long-term plugin SDK capability, including its exact-profile, no-refresh, token-free, and agent-scoped contract?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API with authentication and provider-routing semantics; source review can assess implementation safety but cannot decide whether the long-term product contract belongs in the SDK.

options.title: Approve the constrained SDK seam
options.body: Accept the token-free, exact-profile API after an owner confirms the supported consumers and contract, then require live redacted proof before merge.

options.title: Keep usage reads owner-specific
options.body: Avoid a general SDK method and move the capability behind a provider or feature-owner integration if no reusable plugin contract is intended.

options.title: Defer the API
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the supported plugin use cases, error behavior, and compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve the constrained SDK seam
recommendation.body: Accept the token-free, exact-profile API after an owner confirms the supported consumers and contract, then require live redacted proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context does not establish a named current-main owner for the plugin runtime contract.
